verdict: Paid channels are dark; organic engagement is softening across all three locations.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, there was no paid spend on Meta or Google Ads this period, meaning all 402 combined Google Business Profile actions are the only measurable activity driving engagement. GBP actions are declining week-over-week at every location — down 27% at Forte Metals, 26% at Advance Grinding, and 54% at O'Hare Precision — with the sharpest drop concentrated in the final three days of the period. Three CRM milestones from July are overdue and being resolved now, with stub reconciliation and contact pulls targeted for completion this week. Once those blockers clear, outreach sequences and paid reactivation can move forward, which is where lead volume will come from next period.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations this period
paid leads generated this period — no Meta or Google Ads spend was active

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement is declining sharply at all three locations, most severely at O'Hare Precision, with near-zero activity in the final days of the period.
watch_item.fix: The root cause of profile visibility loss has been identified and a fix has been submitted today; reindexing across all three sites is targeted for completion by end of October.
